name: Grafana Mimir (Self-Hosted)
free_limit: AGPL-3.0-only open-source horizontally scalable Prometheus-compatible metrics storage; no vendor-enforced ingestion or retention quota in the self-managed software.
watch_out: Running Mimir requires self-managed compute and object storage, potentially significant operational costs; AGPL-3.0 network-source obligations may apply to modified deployments. Grafana Cloud pricing is separate.
